title: A write-off credits each non-zero portion to its own receivable slot and debits the total ONCE to losses-written-off (loan 13 L57: four credits 92115.12 / 5618.53 / 100.00 / 57.00, one debit 97890.65)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the FIVE-LEG journal entry the SECOND observed loan write-off posted, on the running Fineract server under tenant gerege (loan 13, externalId OHWOPAID-L01, product 3 OHLGR-Accrual-Loan, ACCRUAL PERIODIC) at business date 2026-09-03. request.write_off_journal.portions transcribes the write-off transaction's four portions in integer minor units from out/loan-13-after-transactions-raw.json content[id 57] (type loanTransactionType.writeOff): principalPortion 92115.12, interestPortion 5618.53, feeChargesPortion 100.0, penaltyChargesPortion 57.0, overpaymentPortion absent. request.write_off_journal.accounts is the SAME product-3 slot->account mapping LN-L11-writeoff-journal-five-legs cites, read back from GET /loanproducts/3 accountingMappings on TODAY's oracle instance (capture investor-asset-transfer-100/out/loanproduct-3-raw.json): loanPortfolioAccount OHLGR-10010, receivableInterestAccount OHLGR-10012, receivableFeeAccount OHLGR-10013, receivablePenaltyAccount OHLGR-10014, overpaymentLiabilityAccount OHLGR-20011, writeOffAccount OHLGR-50010. expect.write_off_journal_legs is a TRANSCRIPTION of the five L57 legs in id order from out/loan-13-after-journalentries-raw.json: JE 150 CREDIT OHLGR-10010 92115.12, JE 151 CREDIT OHLGR-10012 5618.53, JE 152 CREDIT OHLGR-10013 100.00, JE 153 CREDIT OHLGR-10014 57.00, JE 154 DEBIT OHLGR-50010 97890.65. THIS VECTOR GRADES ONE PROPERTY: a write-off credits each non-zero portion to its own receivable slot and debits the total ONCE to the losses-written-off slot. The four NON-ZERO portions land in four DISTINCT accounts and the fee (10000) differs from the penalty (5700), so the same drives as the loan-11 journal vector are discriminated: one debit per portion (the leg count and sides move while the batch still balances); debits the principal only (the debit is 9211512 and the batch no longer balances); debits loan portfolio instead of losses-written-off (the account cell moves and every total still balances); and swaps the fee and penalty receivable slots (fee 10000 != penalty 5700, so it cannot hide). WHAT THIS VECTOR DOES NOT GRADE: the same-account merge (accountMap) — product 3 maps the four slots to four DIFFERENT accounts, so a port that never merges posts the SAME five legs and no drive is registered; the zero-portion skip — every portion here is > 0; overpayment and the write-off-reason mapping — absent here; and the charged-off branch — loan 13 was not charged off. A capture of a write-off whose slots share one GL account, or one carrying a zero portion, an overpayment portion, a write-off reason or a charged-off loan would be needed to grade those. Nothing was computed by this promotion: every portion, every account and every expected leg is read directly from the committed files.

The captures are single-line JSON documents, so each observation is cited at line 1. capture_case_id names the write-off transaction id L57, which appears in the referenced journal-entries capture. .softhouse/capture/tierA-a2/ was NOT used: it came from an EARLIER oracle instance whose product ids name different products. No value was synthesised.
